q: In which year were the Montreal Canadiens founded?
sub: Founded on 4 December 1909, eight years before the NHL existed.

q: In which league did the Canadiens play before the NHL was formed in 1917?
sub: They were a charter member of the National Hockey Association in 1909.

q: Who founded the Montreal Canadiens in 1909 as a charter team of the NHA?
sub: O'Brien wanted a team for Montreal's francophone fans.

q: By the end of 2025-26, how many Stanley Cups had the Montreal Canadiens won?
sub: The last one came in 1993.

q: Against which team did the Canadiens win their first Stanley Cup, in 1916?
sub: Montreal won the best-of-five series 3-2 as NHA champions.

q: Which team did Montreal beat in the 1986 Stanley Cup Final?
sub: Calgary got revenge in the 1989 Final.

q: How old was Patrick Roy when he won the Conn Smythe Trophy in 1986, the youngest winner ever?
sub: He was a rookie that spring.

q: In which round did Montreal draft goalie Patrick Roy in 1984?
sub: He went 51st overall.

q: Which Canadiens captain was traded to Colorado together with Patrick Roy in December 1995?
sub: Both won the Cup with Colorado that same season.

q: Which goalie did Montreal get from Colorado in the 1995 Patrick Roy trade?
sub: Martin Rucinsky and Andrei Kovalenko came too.

q: After being pulled in the 11-1 loss in 1995, Patrick Roy told which club president it was his last game in Montreal?
sub: He walked past coach Mario Tremblay to say it.

q: Which jersey number did Maurice Richard wear for Montreal?
sub: Gordie Howe wore 9 too, for Detroit.

q: Which number did the Canadiens retire for Jean Beliveau?
Which number did the Canadiens retire for their first superstar, Howie Morenz?
Montreal's number 12 is retired for Yvan Cournoyer and which other forward?
sub: Lach and Henri Richard share number 16 instead.

q: Which Canadiens defenceman's number 19 hangs in the Bell Centre rafters?
sub: Robinson was known as Big Bird.

q: By 2026, how many different jersey numbers had the Canadiens retired?
sub: Those 15 numbers honour 18 players.

q: Which goalie's number 29 did the Canadiens retire?
sub: Plante's number 1 is retired too.

q: Ken Dryden won the Conn Smythe Trophy in 1971, one year before winning which award?
sub: He is the only player to win playoff MVP before rookie of the year.

q: Which team drafted Ken Dryden in 1964, then traded him to Montreal days later?
sub: He never played a game for Boston.

q: Ken Dryden sat out the 1973-74 season in a contract dispute. What did he do instead?
sub: He articled at a Toronto firm to finish his McGill law degree.

q: Which Canadiens great won 11 Stanley Cups as a player?
sub: Beliveau won 10, Cournoyer 10 and the Rocket 8.

q: What was Henri Richard, Maurice's younger brother, nicknamed?

sub: He captained Montreal from 1975 to 1979.

q: Which Canadiens winger of the 1950s was nicknamed Boom Boom for his hard shot?
sub: He is often credited with making the slapshot popular.

q: What was the 1940s Montreal line of Elmer Lach, Toe Blake and Maurice Richard called?
How many regular-season goals did Maurice Richard score in his career, all for Montreal?
sub: He was the first NHL player to reach 500.

q: Which left winger scored 60 goals for Montreal in 1976-77, a club record Guy Lafleur matched a year later?
sub: Lafleur had 136 points that same season, also a club record.

q: Which player did Montreal take first overall in the 1971 draft?
sub: Dionne went second, to Detroit.

q: Montreal drafted which centre first overall in 1980, famously passing on local star Denis Savard?
sub: Savard went third to Chicago and made the Hall of Fame.

q: Until 1969, the NHL draft let Montreal take which players before any other team?
o: Any two players from its farm clubs
sub: It was a cultural option, used in 1968 and 1969.

q: With the first two picks of the 1969 draft, Montreal took Marc Tardif and which future Canadiens GM?
sub: Houle went first overall.

q: The 1955 Richard Riot broke out on which holiday?
sub: 17 March 1955, at the Forum and on Sainte-Catherine Street.

q: Which team were the Canadiens playing on the night of the 1955 Richard Riot?
sub: A tear gas bomb went off and the game was forfeited to Detroit.

q: Maurice Richard was suspended in 1955 after attacking which Bruins player and then punching a linesman?
sub: Richard knocked linesman Cliff Thompson unconscious.

q: With Maurice Richard suspended in 1955, which teammate passed him for the scoring title by one point?
sub: Some Montreal fans booed Geoffrion for it.

q: For which team was the Montreal Forum originally built, in 1924?
sub: The Canadiens moved in for the 1926-27 season.

q: The legend of the Forum ghosts is linked to whose 1937 funeral, held on the Forum ice?
sub: Fans believed the ghosts of dead legends helped the Habs win at the Forum.

q: Montreal beat which team in the last NHL game at the Forum, on 11 March 1996?
sub: Montreal won 4-1.

q: At the Forum's closing ceremony in 1996, a torch was passed from ex-captain to ex-captain. Who received it last?
sub: Emile Bouchard carried it out first. Turgeon was the captain then.

q: As of 2026, what fills most of the old Montreal Forum building?
sub: Dawson College uses the upper floors.

q: What was the Bell Centre called when it opened in 1996?
sub: Bell Canada bought the naming rights in 2002.

q: Which French nickname for the Canadiens means the glorious ones?
The Canadiens' red sweater is called La Sainte-Flanelle. What does that mean?
The Canadiens' motto, To you from failing hands we throw the torch, comes from which poem?
sub: It is written on the dressing room wall.

q: Who wrote In Flanders Fields, whose torch line is the Canadiens' motto?
sub: McCrae was a Canadian army doctor, writing in 1915.

q: Saku Koivu, Montreal's captain from 1999 to 2009, came from which country?
sub: He was the first European-born captain in club history.

q: In April 2002, Saku Koivu came back from what to an eight-minute standing ovation?
sub: He had been diagnosed with Burkitt's lymphoma in September 2001.

q: Which trophy did Saku Koivu win in 2002 for his perseverance after cancer?
Which team did Saku Koivu join in 2009 after leaving Montreal?
sub: His brother Mikko played for Minnesota.

sub: Tomas Tatar and a second-round pick came to Montreal too.

sub: Montreal had the fewest points of the 16 playoff teams that year.

q: Who scored in overtime of Game 6 to beat Vegas and send Montreal to the 2021 Final?
sub: A year later he scored a series-winning OT goal for Colorado against Edmonton.

sub: The curve was illegal and Montreal tied the game on the power play.

q: Which Montreal defenceman scored all three goals in Game 2 of the 1993 Final, including the OT winner?
sub: No other defenceman has scored a hat trick in a Cup Final game.

q: Which Canadien scored the winning goal in Game 5, clinching the 1993 Stanley Cup?
How many Stanley Cups did Scotty Bowman win as coach of the Canadiens?
sub: From 1973 to 1979, including four in a row.

q: Which rookie head coach led Montreal to the 1986 Stanley Cup?
Which coach won the 1971 Stanley Cup in his only season behind Montreal's bench?
In February 2022, Martin St. Louis took over as Canadiens coach from whom?
sub: St. Louis started as interim coach and got the job for good in June 2022.

sub: Tampa Bay beat his old team Calgary in the 2004 Final.

q: Which GM built Montreal teams that won nine Stanley Cups between 1965 and 1978?
Which former Canadiens defenceman was the GM for the 1986 and 1993 Cups?
Before Montreal hired him as GM in January 2022, what was Kent Hughes's job?
sub: His clients included Patrice Bergeron and Kris Letang.

q: Which GM did Kent Hughes replace in Montreal?
sub: Bergevin ran the team from 2012 to 2021.

q: Which former Rangers GM did Montreal hire in November 2021 to run hockey operations?
Which American businessman owned the Canadiens from 2001 to 2009?
sub: He sold the club back to a Molson-led group.

q: Carey Price is a member of which First Nation?
sub: His father flew him to youth games in a small plane.

q: In 2019, Carey Price passed which goalie for the most wins in Canadiens history?
sub: Price finished with 361 wins.

q: In September 2025, Montreal traded Carey Price's contract to which team?
sub: A cap move. Price's last game was in April 2022.

q: In 2014-15, Carey Price won the Hart, Vezina, Ted Lindsay and which other award, a first for a goalie?
sub: No goalie had won all four in one season before.

q: Which Islanders defenceman did Montreal get in June 2025 for two first-round picks and Emil Heineman?
sub: Dobson signed an eight-year deal right away.

q: Ivan Demidov scored in his NHL debut in April 2025 against which team?
sub: He had a goal and an assist in the first period at the Bell Centre.

q: Ivan Demidov played in the KHL for which club before joining Montreal?
In which round of the 2022 draft did Montreal pick Lane Hutson?
sub: He went 62nd overall and won the Calder three years later.

q: Lane Hutson's 60 assists in 2024-25 tied whose record for a rookie defenceman?
Which Canadiens winger scored 51 goals in 2025-26?
sub: He also won the Lady Byng Trophy for sportsmanship.

q: Before Cole Caufield in 2025-26, who was the last Canadien to score 50 goals, in 1989-90?
Before Nick Suzuki in 2025-26, who was the last Canadien with 100 points, in 1985-86?
sub: Suzuki finished with 101 points.

q: Which award did Cole Caufield win in 2021, as the best player in US college hockey?
sub: He played for the University of Wisconsin.

q: At the 2022 Olympics, which 17-year-old future Canadien was named tournament MVP?
sub: He led the tournament with seven goals as Slovakia won bronze.

q: Which team did Montreal beat in Game 7 of the 2026 first round?
sub: Slafkovsky scored an overtime hat trick in Game 1.

q: In the 2026 second round, Montreal won Game 7 in overtime on the road against which team?
Which Canadien won the first four Selke Trophies, from 1978 to 1981?
The Vezina Trophy for the best goalie is named after a goalie of which team?
sub: Georges Vezina died of tuberculosis in 1926.

q: Which Canadiens goalie won Olympic gold for Canada at Sochi in 2014?
sub: He was named the best goalie of the tournament.

q: Montreal's fierce provincial rival in the 1980s, in the Battle of Quebec, was which team?
sub: The Nordiques moved to Denver in 1995 and became the Avalanche.
